leakage.ts_convention: ohlcv ts is the Binance kline OPEN time (row[0]); the OHLC of bar t is only final at t+1. Features and targets are both indexed at bar t, so they are internally consistent provided execution occurs no earlier than the close of bar t.

btc_trailing_24h_vs_market_return.note: informative: trailing BTC state vs mean forward return

breadth_vs_market_return.note: CIRCULAR BY CONSTRUCTION: breadth is the fraction of symbols with a positive forward return and the market return is the mean of those same forward returns, so high correlation only verifies panel coherence and carries no predictive information

btc_forward_vs_market_return.note: CIRCULAR BY CONSTRUCTION: BTC's forward return is one of the terms in the mean forward return, so this measures BTC's weight in the basket
